summary: Find recurring agent communication failures in Codex conversations and propose the smallest guidance fixes for approval.

scenarios.title: Review a frustrating project task
scenarios.prompt: Use $agent-self-improve to review this project's recent tasks. Focus on why the agent kept asking questions the repository already answered.
scenarios.outcome: A diagnosis tied to conversation evidence and numbered, approval-gated edits for the narrowest guidance layer.

scenarios.title: Evaluate a supplied transcript
scenarios.prompt: Use $agent-self-improve on this transcript and explain whether the failure came from execution, a skill, or project instructions.
scenarios.outcome: A scoped cause analysis that does not blame prompt wording or edit agent configuration without approval.
